Name: Pokemon PokeFarm Animal Replacer
Author: Wolfina2
Description:
A simple sprite replacer just add this folder into your Mods folder alongside ContentPatcher and run with SMAPI and it'll be good to go!  
[b][u][b]
[/b][/u][/b]If you have any questions or suggestions feel free to drop me a line! Make sure to check the Future Plans.txt to see what I currently have planned for the future sprites!

Currently replaces: 
Brown Cow
White Cow
Baby Brown Cows
Baby White Cows
Sheep 
Baby Sheep 
Rabbits 
Baby Rabbits 
Shop icons for Marina's Ranch
White Chicken
